name: Wonders of Aztec

features.name: Reel multipliers
features.description: Bombs add or double a reel's multiplier up to 128x, and the sum of all reels applies at the end of a tumble.

features.name: Persistent free spins
features.description: 4–6 scatters award 10–30 free spins where reel multipliers carry over between spins.

features.name: Super bonus
features.description: A super scatter in the trigger boosts the starting reel multipliers before the free spins begin.

review:
A tumbling Aztec game built around reel multipliers. Bombs can land on any spin or tumble – adding a 2x multiplier to their reel, or doubling it on a win, up to 128x. Super bombs upgrade every reel at once, and the final win gets the sum of all reel multipliers.

Four, five or six scatters give 10, 20 or 30 free spins where reel multipliers never reset, so they keep building. A super scatter drops random bombs first. 96.55% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
